verdict.rationale: Graphite's documentation covers both halves of the story. AI reviews suggest fixes that can be applied in one click from the review page. The Agent, launched from the PR page, makes code changes that are committed directly to the branch and appear in the PR like any other commit, and it can also open a draft follow-up PR. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that review findings flow cleanly into applied, committed fixes.
